analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see stance maintained. RSI has entered oversold territory (31.1), but MACD histogram is worsening (-335.1573) and in a bearish convergence. ADX (27.9) shows a clear trend strength, but -DI (37.7) significantly exceeds +DI (15.7), indicating downward pressure dominance. Five consecutive down days (-6.62%, -5.69%) show a continuing downtrend. Positioned at 25.5% of the 52-week low (53,925 KRW). At the current price of 79,005 KRW, there is approximately 4.4% downside to the swing support level (75,595 KRW).

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): considering potential for further decline, maintaining wait-and-see stance.
